subagents.name: security-reviewer
subagents.provenance: Ran and produced findings, but executed without edit rights and could not write its file. Output transcribed into security.json by the orchestrator.

subagents.name: style-reviewer
subagents.provenance: Same as security-reviewer: ran, produced findings, could not write. Transcribed into style.json by the orchestrator.

provenance_caveat: Two of the four subagents (security, style) were dispatched without file-write permission and returned their findings as chat output; the orchestrator transcribed those into security.json and style.json. tests.json and docs.json were written directly by their subagents. All four subagents did execute concurrently — see parallelism_evidence — but the raw files for security and style are second-hand and should not be cited as direct agent output.
parallelism_evidence: Video frame at t=175s shows all four subagent cards from a single dispatch with durations 6s / 1m21s / 1m38s / 1m38s, confirming concurrent execution with staggered completion.
dedupe_note: 37 findings before dedupe, 17 after. 20 collapsed into 9 merged entries under the orchestrator's file+symbol rule, with every reviewer's reason preserved inside the merged finding. Report 17 as the finding count and 37 as the pre-merge total; both are in this file.
